# contextforge_gateway (Resource)

Manages a ContextForge gateway resource



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Gateway name
- `transport` (String) Transport protocol (SSE, HTTP, etc.)
- `url` (String) Gateway URL endpoint

### Optional

- `auth_header_key` (String) Custom auth header key
- `auth_header_value` (String, Sensitive) Custom auth header value
- `auth_headers` (List of Map of String, Sensitive) List of authentication headers
- `auth_password` (String, Sensitive) Password for basic authentication
- `auth_query_param_key` (String) Authentication query parameter key
- `auth_query_param_value` (String, Sensitive) Authentication query parameter value
- `auth_token` (String, Sensitive) Token for bearer authentication
- `auth_type` (String) Authentication type (basic, bearer, authheaders, oauth)
- `auth_username` (String) Username for basic authentication
- `auth_value` (String, Sensitive) Raw authentication value
- `description` (String) Gateway description
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the gateway is enabled (default: true)
- `oauth_config` (Dynamic, Sensitive) OAuth configuration
- `passthrough_headers` (List of String) Headers to pass through to the gateway
- `tags` (List of String) Gateway tags
- `team_id` (String) Team ID
- `visibility` (String) Visibility setting (public, private, etc.)

### Read-Only

- `auth_query_param_value_masked` (String) Masked authentication query parameter value
- `capabilities` (Dynamic) Gateway capabilities
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC3339 format)
- `created_by` (String) User who created the gateway
- `created_from_ip` (String) IP address of creator
- `created_user_agent` (String) User agent of creator
- `created_via` (String) Creation method
- `federation_source` (String) Federation source
- `id` (String) Gateway ID
- `import_batch_id` (String) Import batch ID
- `last_refresh_at` (String) Last gateway refresh timestamp (RFC3339 format)
- `last_seen` (String) Last seen timestamp (RFC3339 format)
- `modified_by` (String) User who last modified the gateway
- `modified_from_ip` (String) IP address of modifier
- `modified_user_agent` (String) User agent of modifier
- `modified_via` (String) Modification method
- `owner_email` (String) Owner email
- `reachable` (Boolean) Whether the gateway is currently reachable
- `refresh_interval_seconds` (Number) Gateway automatic refresh interval in seconds
- `slug` (String) Gateway slug
- `team` (String) Team name (read-only)
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp (RFC3339 format)
- `version` (Number) Gateway version
